Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE full-body Crooked Witch side-view base sprite candidate, NOT a sheet. The provided Image/Enemy/crooked-witch-256.png is the sole canonical visual reference; preserve her youthful face, silver-white curled long hair, deep purple and gold robes, ivory layered inner skirt, ornate crescent/star details, dark boots, bent pointed broad-brim hat and exact ornate dark-and-gold staff with violet crystal. Match reference crisp detailed pixel-art game sprite rendering, not painterly or photorealistic.
1024x1024 transparent PNG. Character faces RIGHT, near-profile three-quarter side view suitable for a horizontal action game, torso/hips mostly side-on, face and nose pointing right, NOT front-facing. Camera sees her anatomical RIGHT side. Anatomical RIGHT arm is NEAR camera, foreground in front of torso, and RIGHT HAND alone holds the ONE staff in a credible closed grip around the middle-lower shaft, thumb opposing fingers. LEFT arm is FAR side, behind torso, never crosses over the chest; left hand is empty. No floating orb, no spell, no ambient particles. Entire body, boots, hat and whole staff visible.
Use consistent framing for all four candidate variants: feet baseline y=950, head crown excluding hat approximately y=380, hat tip around y=140. Preserve reference body proportions; staff top near hat height, shaft reaches near foot height. Consistent head/body/weapon scale, camera and lighting. Keep roomy transparent margins.
Preserve the exact same character identity, body height, head size, shoulder width, limb proportions, weapon size, camera distance, foot position and lighting as the reference. Right-facing three-quarter side view, full body and the entire weapon inside the frame, flat transparent background, no shadow, no text, no border, no scenery.
Centering and framing are positioning choices only: never zoom, scale, stretch or shrink the character to center it or to fit the full body/weapon. This applies whether the weapon is raised, lowered or held horizontally. If the weapon makes the silhouette taller or wider, keep the character and weapon scale fixed and expand the canvas/margins or adjust the framing instead. If the canonical runtime frame still cannot contain the full weapon at the fixed scale, stop and ask the user; do not shrink the character or crop the weapon.
Correct near/far layering: the near RIGHT arm and near RIGHT leg are in front of the torso; the far LEFT arm and far LEFT leg stay behind it. The staff is held by the same RIGHT hand with a believable grip around the shaft; fingers wrap the shaft, and the hand/staff do not intersect torso, head, legs, hair or clothing. No interpenetration, no merged or extra limbs, no floating parts, and no duplicated weapon.
Only change the pose for a neutral grounded standing BASE. Neutral balanced stance, right boot half a step ahead, near right elbow naturally bent, right hand at waist height holding staff almost upright just forward of the body, crystal well clear of brim. Far left arm relaxed down behind the body, fingers visible beside far hip. Calm confident expression.
